name: What does kitchen finish carpentry include?

mainEntity.name: What does kitchen finish carpentry include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen finish carpentry includes the final, visible woodwork and trim installed after major structural work, plumbing, and drywall are finished. In a kitchen remodel, this covers installing custom cabinetry, crown molding, baseboards, door and window casings, decorative island paneling, light rail moldings, and floating shelves. It also involves scribing filler strips and end panels so that factory cabinets fit flush against uneven walls. Because finish carpentry serves as the bridge between raw framing and decorative paint or tile, precision cuts and tight joints are essential to prevent visible seams and gaps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen finish carpentry includes installing custom cabinets, crown molding, baseboards, window casings, island paneling, light rails, and scribing filler panels to uneven walls.
